description.p: Arynwood Cutroom is a video editor built on Kdenlive, with an assistant inside the editor window. Describe an edit in plain language and the Cutroom Assistant carries it out on your timeline, using a model that runs on your own computer, and asks before it changes your project.

ul.li: The Cutroom Assistant panel, opened from the Launch Assistant button
A scripting interface and 183 tools that AI agents and scripts can use to operate the editor
Jamendo and Openverse as additional Creative Commons media sources

description.p: This is an early alpha. The assistant needs Ollama, or another OpenAI-compatible service, with a model that supports tool calling, and the mcp-kdenlive tool server. Small local models are unreliable at multi-step edits, which is why the assistant asks before every change by default.
Arynwood Cutroom is a modified version of Kdenlive and is not made or endorsed by the KDE project or the Kdenlive team. Kdenlive project files open in both.
First alpha: the Cutroom Assistant panel with its Launch Assistant button, Arynwood branding, and bug reports directed to Arynwood.
